_comment: Copy this to local.settings.json (gitignored) and adjust the absolute paths. PYTHONPATH MUST include both the repo root AND .funcvenv/Lib/site-packages — the Functions worker needs the latter to import azure.durable_functions / azure.identity / agent_framework etc. Without it, cold start hits ModuleNotFoundError. local.settings.json Values WIN over env vars set in the parent shell, so this is the only reliable place to pin PYTHONPATH.

Values._governance_comment: Phase 6 of plan/feature-agent-governance-toolkit-1.md. AGT_ENFORCE flips the kernel from log-only (records every deny but never raises) to enforce (raises GovernanceDenied on a deny, which renders as a workflow exception). Default: '0' (log-only) so existing tests + the autonomous loop keep passing while the registry settles. Flip to '1' once you've iterated registries to convergence. AGT_DEFAULT_ACTOR labels un-attributed call_mcp() invocations; the gate skips that literal so legacy paths don't auto-deny under enforce.
